$comment: claude-mini config schema (ADR-0031 §4). A deliberately small typed subset, not JSON Schema: node types object|string|int|bool|array|enum; object nodes list 'properties' and 'required'; array nodes give 'items'; enum nodes give 'values'. Unknown keys are rejected. Validated by plugin/bin/config.

base_branch.doc: Branch reviews and diffs compare against.

scope_pattern.doc: ERE for the optional (scope), without parentheses.

skip_prefixes.doc: Subjects starting with these are not checked (git autosquash markers).

version.doc: Pinned npm version run via npx; never installed globally.

language.doc: Language for reports shown to the user, e.g. en, ru.

run_dir.doc: Project-relative directory for harness state, reports and backups.
